music.prompt: Stark expressionist chamber score in the spirit of a 1930 anti-war film: a low bowed contrabass drone and a single muffled frame drum like a slow heartbeat, sparse and heavy, minor mode, about 56 BPM; at about 3.5 seconds a sudden harsh dissonant string cluster swells and tears apart, then sinks into grieving low cellos; from 10 seconds a distant mournful brass call over the drone, dread and loss, restrained, no melody resolving; no synths, no drum kit

A small, tender hope after grief: soft high strings open onto a warm quiet major chord, a single gentle celesta note and a faint solo violin rising a few notes, very slow and hushed, glowing, then held to silence
